Nigerian singer Ayra Starr has been named among the artistes billed to perform at the 2027 edition of the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival in California, United States. The organisers announced the lineup in a statement shared on Wednesday, listing the Mavin Records star among performers scheduled for Sunday, April 11 and 18. Reacting to the announcement in the comments, Ayra Starr wrote, “Let’s gooo.” The 2027 festival will be held across two weekends, from April 9 to 11 and April 16 to 18, at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California. Other major acts on the lineup include Dua Lipa, SZA, Tame Impala, Madonna, Phoebe Bridgers, Weezer, Mariah the Scientist, Don Toliver, Kygo and Daddy Yankee. In its announcement, Coachella said, “The return of innocence. Passes on sale Friday 11/13 at 12pm PT.” The festival’s 2027 edition will mark another appearance by a Nigerian artiste at the major international music event, following Davido’s performance at the 2026 edition. Christabel Ndoeche
